system.description:
It is common knowledge that to cross a Malkavian is to invite a fate worse than destruction. With this offshoot of Dementation, the Malkavian causes its target to become a living (or unliving) ghost — fading from view, possibly never to be seen or heard from again, depending on the Malkavian's own outlook: swallowed by shadows, devoured by demons, or swept away by angels.

System: The vampire must lock gazes with the victim and curse him, rolling Manipulation + Stealth against a difficulty equal to the target's Willpower rating. Successes determine the duration of the effect: 1/one turn, 2/one scene, 3/one night, 4/one week, 5+/one month. While vanished, the victim fades from the perception of others and is rendered delirious, able to do nothing but babble to himself and seek shelter from the sun; a sufficiently long Vanishing can doom the victim to torpor. The Vanishing costs 20 experience to learn.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis IV: Thieves in the Night, Book Three: Madmen
